C9000236.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 236 (The exact factor-of-IID threshold for free Ising spins on trees.; papers: The sharp factor-of-IID threshold for the free Ising model on regular trees; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/236.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_CE_VERIFICATION.statement: For every d >= 3, at theta = (d-1)^(-1/2), the actual innovation-conditioned copies obey both stated weighted-path bounds and have V(t)=0 for every t >= 0. No observation-recovery map is assumed.

C_CE_WEIGHTED.statement: Uniform dependent-weight Q_r and L_r bounds, with the length restriction and exceptional tails, follow by invariant averaging in both path orientations.

C_CE_CUT.statement: Deleting the entering message makes inward continuations component-local at log cost at most 4 beta/(1-theta), while intact infinite side components give both conditional attenuation bounds and double-exponential concentration.

C_CE_LOCALITY.statement: Infinite posterior component fields have component-local causal versions; broadcast cylinder factorization extends to their full history sigma-fields, including below a conditioned cut.

C_CE_INFORMATION.statement: At criticality the intact infinite-component information M(t) is bounded above and below by degree-dependent positive multiples of min(sqrt(t),1), with a shifted side-message attenuation input.

C_CE_SPECTRAL.statement: For every invariant joining with the planted observation marginals, directed-edge differences of square-integrable equivariant marginal functions have path-sum variance at most C_d r S.

C_CE_INNOVATIONS.statement: The infinite filter has no residual covariance energy, its field equation transports to the actual compatible conditional joining, and V is absolutely continuous with the stated variance-path reduction.

C_CE_MOMENTS.statement: All integer field moments are bounded by exp(K p^2) t^(p/4), uniformly in p and small t, yielding the log-squared exceptional-field tail and the discrepancy-sensitive small-log-factor estimate.

C_CE_CLOSURE.statement: For every finite T, H>0 and K>max(1,H^2), an absolutely continuous V:[0,T]->[0,H^2] starting at zero vanishes if its nonnegative S,Q_r,L_r obey the unweighted, exponential plus double-exponential, and a.e. variance-reduction hypotheses in PROOF.md section 9, and S<=C V[t^delta+(1+log(K/V))/log^q(1/t)] at small positive times on {V>0}, for any fixed delta>0,q>1. These hypotheses need not imply V=0 at q=1; this is method sharpness, not a manuscript refutation.

C_CE_ALGEBRA.statement: The binary-signal fusion identity and loss bound, critical all-order moment gap, inverse two-message comparison, and endpoint companion-matrix power formula hold with the explicit hypotheses encoded in Main.lean.
